title: RFID spool runs out, auto-switch to a second spool of the same filament
notes: Spool 10 has 30 g (3%); it feeds the first 30% of the print and runs out, the AMS switches to spool 11 (same filament) which uses 70 g (100% -> 93%). Slicer: 100 g. Spool 10 must end at 0 g and location Empty; spool 11 charged its own 70 g; no alert. Runout model: the AMS reports the ran-out tray Empty with tag_uid/tray_uuid zeros and colour #00000000 (to confirm from a real runout); the active tray reads none while it switches.

xfail.reason: an all-zero tray_uuid after the runout reads as a spool swap: spool never set Empty, no depletion alert
